ValidationRule.description: Prevents unauthorized agent modification of intake and SLA metrics, with Custom Permission bypass and initial CSAT survey response exemption.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Case_Lock), NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED(AccountId), ISCHANGED(ContactId), ISCHANGED(EntitlementId), ISCHANGED(Origin), ISCHANGED(Customer_Product__c), AND( ISCHANGED(Customer_Rating__c), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Customer_Rating__c)))) ), AND( ISCHANGED(Feedback_Comments__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Feedback_Comments__c))) ), ISCHANGED(SLA_Breached__c), ISCHANGED(SLAViolation__c), ISCHANGED(Reopened_Count__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Rule Violation: Customer intake data (Account, Contact, Origin, Product), CSAT ratings/feedback, and System SLA metrics cannot be modified or removed by agents.
